decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing Cloudpost lands to ramp up mana quickly in order to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Ulamog and Emrakul. The deck also uses various spells and artifacts to disrupt the opponent's strategy and protect its own creatures. By using cards like Crop Rotation and Karn, the Great Creator to search for specific lands or artifacts, the deck aims to establish a dominant board presence and overwhelm the opponent with its powerful creatures and disruptive spells.

This aggro Death & Taxes deck focuses on utilizing various creatures with disruptive abilities to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By using cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, Skyclave Apparition, and Flickerwisp to hinder the opponent's resources, combined with Aether Vial for mana acceleration and Stoneforge Mystic to fetch powerful equipment like Kaldra Compleat, the deck aims to pressure the opponent while maintaining control of the game. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion adds value and versatility to the deck's strategy by providing additional card advantage and synergy with its blink effects.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through card advantage, countering spells, and removing threats. It utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Tamiyo and Jace, along with versatile cards like Snapcaster Mage and Force of Will. The deck aims to stabilize with removal like Swords to Plowshares and board wipes like Terminus, while generating card advantage with cards like Scroll Rack and Consign to Memory. The win condition is often through overwhelming the opponent with angels from Entreat the Angels or locking them out with Counterbalance. The deck also includes some extra versatility with cards like Time Warp and Prismatic Ending.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures and then bringing them back onto the battlefield for a strong, explosive combo. By utilizing cards like Entomb, Faithless Looting, and Reanimate, the deck aims to cheat out creatures like Griselbrand and Ashen Rider to overwhelm the opponent. Additionally, the deck includes disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Cabal Therapy to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The goal is to quickly assemble a lethal board state and outvalue the opponent in order to win the game.

The key concept of this Legacy Combo - Show and Tell deck is to cheat out powerful, game-ending creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Archon of Cruelty as quickly as possible using cards like Show and Tell and Sneak Attack. The deck aims to disrupt opponent's strategies with cards like Force of Will and Daze while digging for combo pieces with Brainstorm, Ponder, and Preordain. The mana base is designed to support the fast mana acceleration needed to cast these high-cost creatures, with City of Traitors and Ancient Tomb providing additional ramp.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by using cards like Stifle, Dress Down, Force of Will, and Brainstorm to disrupt your opponent's strategy. The deck aims to stall the game and protect key cards like Phyrexian Dreadnought, while generating card advantage with Nulldrifter and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. By utilizing counterspells, removal, and card draw, this deck seeks to outvalue the opponent and ultimately win through a combination of control and efficient threats. Additionally, it includes cards like Doorkeeper Thrull for additional disruption and protection.

The deck aims to control the board by using cards like Dress Down, Stifle, and Teferi, Time Raveler to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining card advantage through cards like Brainstorm and Ponder. It uses cards like Swords to Plowshares and Force of Will to deal with threats efficiently. The deck also includes powerful threats like True-Name Nemesis and Murktide Regent to close out the game quickly. The mana base is optimized with cards like Wasteland and fetch lands to ensure smooth mana development and consistency in casting spells.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Emrakul, the Aeons Torn, then using cards like Entomb and Reanimate to bring them back into play for a game-winning combo. It also utilizes cards like Brainstorm and Thoughtseize to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. With a mix of acceleration cards like Lotus Petal and Dark Ritual, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and win the game in just a few turns.

The deck focuses on quickly putting powerful creatures into play from the graveyard using cards like "Reanimate" and "Animate Dead." It also includes disruption cards like "Force of Will" and "Thoughtseize" to protect the combo. The key strategy is to efficiently control the game until you can reanimate a game-winning threat, either through raw power like "Archon of Cruelty" or through disruptive abilities like "Atraxa, Grand Unifier." Additionally, the deck utilizes cards like "Brainstorm" and "Ponder" for card selection and consistency.
